sloka: भीम रूपा महाकायाः कस्य वा निहता रणे ।दीप्त पावक संकाशो द्युतिमान् समर ध्वजः ॥३-६४-४७॥
transliteration: bhīma rūpā mahākāyāḥ kasya vā nihatā raṇe ।dīpta pāvaka saṁkāśo dyutimān samara dhvajaḥ ॥3-64-47॥

translations.english: Whose war chariot with a battle flag is this, shining like burning fire, turned upside down and broken?
